name: Acme Orders API (intentionally vulnerable demo)
description: A small Express + Python order-management service written for this hackathon with deliberate security flaws. It is never executed by PandaShield.
appContext: Internet-facing order-management REST API for a small e-commerce store. Customers log in with JWTs, the API stores customer names, addresses and payment references in PostgreSQL, and a Python worker generates nightly PDF reports from uploaded templates. Runs in a Docker container on a public cloud VM.
